name: ANSI/IEEE gapped-core inductor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for gapped-core inductor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The gapped-core inductor form identifies a documented gap in the magnetic circuit. That gap is a construction detail affecting the selected component, while the electrical terminals remain the winding connections.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Do not read the magnetic gap as an open electrical circuit.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A core gap and a disconnector's contact gap describe different physical and electrical relationships.
